posts.title: Trailer - Antecedent Series
posts.author: George S Boughton
posts.summary: Not a film script but a novel with a credible plot, strong characters and powerful screen writing... “shoot from the hip” dialogue... brooding with menace and cinematic quality that encompasses the darkness of Blade Runner, the freneticism of Battlestar Galactica and the time overlap scenes of Star Wars! - TV Presenter JULIETTE FOSTER

posts.title: Preview - Plants & Us
posts.author: George S Boughton
posts.summary: This book is "fascinating" - The Telegraph. It’s packed with amazing facts about plants. Some will intrigue, some will amuse. This book trailer ends on an extremely sobering chapter, the interdependence of plants and animals. On that note, the world is witnessing a peace that could herald the end of wars, a hugely historic moment, and a shift to rebuilding our relationship with nature. A shift that we’d fail in at our peril. And the whole world is watching.

posts.title: Preview - The Ginologist Cook
posts.author: George S Boughton
posts.summary: “The Ginologist Cook”, 150 signature starters, main courses and desserts, in the world's first coffee-table cookery book featuring GIN. And here's a Christmas Day dessert Idea: The Coffee Chocolate Mousse, serving between 2-4 people, just one of the many delicious and richly flavoured recipes curated by The Ginologist Cook! The recipe contains coffee, sugar, dark chocolate and most importantly...Spice Gin! To spice up your home at Christmas, get your copy from our websites.

posts.title: Preview - Seafaring
posts.author: George S Boughton
posts.summary: Seafaring ⚓ a sailing classic of pirates, adventure and above all camaraderie. This edition of ‘The Full Story’ adds his mother’s tragedy when she put the author to sea at the age of 12, and concludes with his fortune at the end. The illustrator Kenneth D Shoesmith RI was a prolific artist, his works included several large pieces for the old Queen Mary, including an altarpiece, The Madonna of the Atlantic for the Cabin Class Drawing Room.

posts.title: Preview - The Zodiac Cooks
posts.author: George S Boughton
posts.summary: Could serving the right food capture a heart? Yes, according to passionate cook Penny Thornton (author of Suns and Lovers) who believes matching meals to personality types can open the route to happy seduction. Want to cook to win a heart? Penny’s advice: spread your love over a perfectly laid table and then serve sensual starters, mouth-watering mains and puddings to provoke passion. Not easy? Yes, could be, with a little help from Zodiac Cooks, a book packed with recipes targeted for love...

posts.title: Preview - Autobiology of a Vet
posts.author: George S Boughton
posts.summary: An enlightening, educational but often hilarious memoir. A great read for anyone interested in animals and especially life as a veterinary surgeon, Covering his travels from the UK, to East Africa (including under dictator Idi Amin) and South Africa.
